# Advanced Methods and Artificial Intelligence

Student presentations in this chapter concern advanced computational methods,
deep learning, natural-language processing, and artificial intelligence.

## Introduction to Neural Networks

[Presentation](../topic/chaoyang-presentation/) by **Chaoyang Wang**.

Introduces neurons, nonlinear activations, forward prediction, and
gradient-based training through a small binary-classification example.
A reproducible two-moons analysis connects the equations to Python and
compares a neural network with a straight-line classifier on held-out data.
The presentation closes with limitations and practical takeaways.
